neighbours.label: negated membership or fit, just before the alternatives are dismissed: 'did not fit / match / belong to any of …', 'not owned by either …' (its output promotes ' none', ' neither')
fire: The fossil skull did not fit any of the species described in the textbooks.
The fingerprint on the glass did not match any of the records in the police database.
The old farmhouse does not belong to either of the two neighbouring parishes.
Her symptoms did not fit neatly into any of the standard diagnostic categories.
The handwriting in the letter did not match that of any of the three suspects.
The stray parcel was not addressed to any of the tenants in the building.
This dialect does not fit into either of the two main branches of the language.
The odd little key did not belong to any of the locks in the house.
quiet: The fossil skull was a close fit for one of the species described in the textbooks.
The fingerprint on the glass matched one of the records in the police database.
The old farmhouse belongs to the larger of the two neighbouring parishes.
Her symptoms fit neatly into the first of the standard diagnostic categories.
The handwriting in the letter matched that of the youngest of the three suspects.
The stray parcel was addressed to one of the tenants in the building.
This dialect fits into the northern branch of the two main branches of the language.
The odd little key belonged to the lock on the cellar door of the house.

short: does not fit any of them
